note: Small family-owned park off I-85 exit 87 near Gaffney/Cowpens; RV sites only, no tent sites. --Claude
summary: Operator's one-page site confirms 50/30-amp, water and sewer at each site, RVs to 45 ft, free internet, phone reservations and Passport America. Note trimmed to what the fields can't say. Not stated: site count, season, any nightly rate.
flags: No nightly rate posted anywhere on the operator's site (copyright 2024): reservations by phone and 'Please call us for monthly prices', so the US$50 gate cannot be checked from its pages and the park may lean long-stay. Not stayed at by the family; no gateway within 40 km (Charlotte 83 km). Presence passes (working website with phone 864-810-8002).
